description: Read the connector's third-party error logs, or aggregated failure patterns when summary_only is true. Only errors from the third-party system are included, so an empty result means no failures, not no traffic. Known limitation: the time range must not exceed 7 DAYS, and only the last 7 days are retained - start_time defaults to 24 hours ago and end_time to now. Unlike the other list tools this one does return an object: {data: [...], stats: {...}}, with stats present only when include_stats is true.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

end_time.description: End of the range, Unix seconds.

start_time.description: Start of the range, Unix seconds. Must be within the last 7 days.

summary_only.description: Return failure patterns instead of entries.

name: mba_get_connector_logs
title: Read connector logs
